changeSet.sql:
CREATE TABLE day_goal ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, updated_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, week_goal_id BIGINT NOT NULL, day_index INTEGER NOT NULL, target_date DATE, when_started TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, when_ended TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, completeness INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, CONSTRAINT uk_day_goal_week_day_index UNIQUE (week_goal_id, day_index), CONSTRAINT fk_day_goal_week FOREIGN KEY (week_goal_id) REFERENCES week_goal (id) ON DELETE CASCADE );
CREATE INDEX idx_day_goal_week ON day_goal (week_goal_id); CREATE INDEX idx_day_goal_date ON day_goal (target_date);
